program_scope.canary_only: Affliction actor 30008 and Chainwielder remain observation identities; the required preflight is generic to every atomic shard input.

scope_lock.allowed_change: Add one deterministic no-live staging/preflight boundary that copies the exact canonical route into the external run root, proves source/staged hash equality, and rejects worktree-contained authoritative inputs before the sole atomic create is counted or invoked.

observed_failure.first_edge: The authoritative create received dataset/validation_scenarios/validation_routes.jsonl inside the mutable worktree and failed closed with route_manifest_inside_mutable_worktree before staging or launch.

required_repair.staging: Copy exact canonical route bytes to a new external run root without altering content.
required_repair.preflight: Before authoritative create, require the staged route is outside the Git worktree and its SHA-256 equals the caller-bound canonical route SHA-256.
required_repair.counting: A location/hash rejection must happen in preflight and must not consume the one authoritative create budget.
required_repair.positive_test: An exact external copy passes and can be supplied unchanged to the existing create boundary.
required_repair.negative_tests: A worktree path, byte drift, symlink escape, missing file, and reused/nonempty destination fail before create.
